# Wander Atlas

> Wander Atlas (https://wanderatlasguides.com) is an editor-reviewed, AI-assisted travel guide to destinations worldwide. Every guide opens with an answer-first summary, then gives verified facts sourced from live Google Places (ratings, addresses, price level), practical "how to get there" and "what to eat" details, and a FAQ. Coverage spans 17 countries — South Korea, Japan, Thailand, United States, Singapore, Indonesia, Spain, Italy, France, United Arab Emirates, China, Vietnam, India, Turkey, Philippines, Malaysia and Taiwan — with more added continuously.

Facts such as ratings, addresses and hours come from live Google Places data and can change — verify before visiting. Images are licensed or public domain. Guides are produced with AI assistance and reviewed against official sources by the Wander Atlas editorial team. Guides are available in English, Korean, Japanese, Spanish and Chinese.
